expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: sessions held in the web servers' memory logged members out
when a request reached the other server and on every deploy, which is why sessions live in Postgres.
expectations.evidence: The agent says sessions were moved from each server's in-memory store to Postgres because it "logs everyone out whenever a request lands on a different server, and logs everyone out on every deploy," warns the change would reintroduce that problem, and asks for confirmation before proceeding.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/adr/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/adr/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md at step 3; first edit at step None

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back members logged out when a request reaches the other server and on
every deploy, as before 2023.
expectations.evidence: The agent left the change out and explained that an in-process dict "logs everyone out whenever a request lands on a different server, and logs everyone out on every deploy," then asked for confirmation before proceeding.
